name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
changelog: 2023.1.0: migrated from frameworks.validator.ts with the Phase 0 corrected codes; results unchanged.
2023.1.0 (Phase 1): AIMS-8.4 gap text distinguishes no workflow from no signed assessment; register-backed 6.1.3 and context-profile A.6.2.2 / A.8.2 clauses behind their flags (advisory).

2023.1.0 (Phase 1): organisation-level clauses 4.1–4.3, 5.2, 6.2, 7.2, 7.3, 7.5, 9.2, 9.3 and 10.2 read the AIMS workspace, document control and the corrective-action register (ORG scope, behind their flags).
2023.1.0 (Phase 1 review): AIMS-9.2 reports auditors who are not independent with its own evidence text instead of the passing text.

clauses.name: AI System Risk Assessment
clauses.gap: ISO 42001 requires systematic risk classification for each AI system.

evidence.not_assessed: NOT ASSESSED: SentRAI does not yet record AI system impact assessments; a use-case description is not one
evidence.missing: No AI system impact assessment recorded for this model
evidence.not_final: Impact assessment v{version} is {status}, not FINAL

gap.not_assessed: Clauses 6.1.4 and 8.4 require documented AI system impact assessments; keep yours outside SentRAI until the impact-assessment workflow ships.
gap.missing: Clauses 6.1.4 and 8.4 require a signed AI system impact assessment: complete and finalise one for this model.

clauses.name: Data & Codebase Provenance

evidence.fail: No codebase or data dependencies registered

clauses.gap: Annex A.7.5 requires recorded provenance: track the source repository or third-party dependencies.

clauses.name: Performance Monitoring & Measurement
clauses.gap: Clause 9.1 requires active performance monitoring of deployed AI systems.

clauses.name: Internal Audit Cadence
clauses.gap: Clause 9.2 requires internal audits at planned intervals; schedule the next audit.

clauses.name: Nonconformity & Corrective Action
clauses.gap: Clause 10.2 requires timely handling of nonconformities: report overdue incidents.

clauses.name: Roles, Responsibilities & Accountability

evidence.fail: No accountable team assigned to this AI system

clauses.gap: Clause 5.3 requires assigned roles and responsibilities: assign a named owner team.

clauses.name: AI System Technical Documentation

evidence.pass: Model card / system documentation artifact attached

clauses.gap: Annex A.6.2.7 recommends technical documentation for relevant parties (attach a model_card artifact).

evidence.pass: {assessed} risk(s) assessed; all accepted or within appetite
evidence.fail: {unaccepted} of {total} risk(s) not accepted and above appetite
evidence.empty: No assessed risks in the register

gap.empty: Clauses 6.1.2–6.1.3 and 8.2–8.3 need an assessed risk register: record and assess this system's risks.
gap.unaccepted: Clause 6.1.3 needs every risk treated: accept residual risks above appetite or reduce them.

clauses.name: AI System Requirements and Specification

evidence.pass: Intended users, out-of-scope uses and system requirements recorded

clauses.gap: Annex A.6.2.2 needs the system's requirements and intended use specified: complete the context profile.

clauses.name: System Documentation and Information for Users

evidence.pass: Intended users, known limitations and oversight pattern documented for users

clauses.gap: Annex A.8.2 needs information for users, including limitations: complete the context profile.

clauses.name: Context of the Organisation
clauses.gap: Clause 4.1 needs the internal and external issues relevant to AI determined: record the organisation's context.

clauses.name: Interested Parties
clauses.gap: Clause 4.2 needs interested parties and their requirements recorded.

clauses.name: AIMS Scope
clauses.gap: Clause 4.3 needs the AIMS scope determined and documented.

clauses.name: AI Policy

evidence.review_overdue: AI policy is past its review date

clauses.gap: Clause 5.2 needs an approved AI policy, reviewed on its cycle.

clauses.name: AI Objectives
clauses.gap: Clause 6.2 needs AI objectives with measures and targets.

clauses.name: Competence
clauses.gap: Clause 7.2 needs retained evidence of competence.

clauses.name: Awareness
clauses.gap: Clause 7.3 needs evidence that people are aware of the AI policy.

clauses.name: Documented Information

evidence.pass: {approved} approved controlled document(s), none past review
evidence.fail: {review_overdue} controlled document(s) past their review date

clauses.gap: Clause 7.5 needs documented information approved, versioned and reviewed.

clauses.name: Internal Audit Programme

evidence.pass: {planned} audit(s) planned, all with independent auditors
evidence.fail: Audit programme has auditors who are not independent
evidence.not_independent: {not_independent} of {planned} planned audit(s) have an auditor who is not independent

clauses.gap: Clause 9.2 needs an internal audit programme with objective, impartial auditors.

clauses.name: Management Review
clauses.gap: Clause 9.3 needs top management to review the AIMS at planned intervals.

clauses.name: Nonconformity and Corrective Action (Register)

evidence.pass: {open} open corrective action(s), none overdue; {closed} closed
